executiveSummary: Failure mode analysis across the 4 ablation conditions on the 35 frozen held-out cases. Highlights critical blind spots of single-prompt RAG (Condition A) and rules-only matching (Condition B) compared to OnBrand's mechanically grounded deterministic and hybrid verification pipelines (Conditions C and D).

failureTaxonomy.draftSnippet: boosts memory and concentration during intense work days
failureTaxonomy.likelyCause: Single-prompt RAG lacks structured statutory fact checking against active claims register. The model treated cognitive enhancement as plausible marketing copy rather than an unapproved structure-function drug claim under FDA 21 CFR 101.93.
failureTaxonomy.proposedCorrection: Implement mechanical topic-gated fact matching against the organization's approved brand claims register (SRC-CLAIMS-01).

failureTaxonomy.draftSnippet: Sponsored creator post omitting mandatory #ad disclosure
failureTaxonomy.likelyCause: Rules-only keyword regex matches present tokens but cannot detect the absence of mandatory statutory disclosures without channel-aware metadata.
failureTaxonomy.proposedCorrection: Implement channel-specific disclosure checks requiring #ad or #sponsored on influencer marketing content per FTC 16 CFR Part 255.

failureTaxonomy.draftSnippet: Packed with 18g of plant-based protein per serving
failureTaxonomy.likelyCause: Unstructured LLM prompt failed to verify numeric formulation constraints against product specification (certified value: 6g protein per 30g serving).
failureTaxonomy.proposedCorrection: Mechanical typed-fact extraction with strict numeric range and attribute-value comparison (C1-C4 verification).

failureTaxonomy.likelyCause: LLM prompt treated all referenced source titles as valid without inspecting server-side metadata fields such as revokedAt or effectiveTo.
failureTaxonomy.proposedCorrection: Server-side mechanical citation gate (validateEvidenceCitation) confirming source.approvalState === 'APPROVED' and source.revokedAt === null.

failureTaxonomy.draftSnippet: Sample Foods Oat Bites contain 50% less sugar than leading energy bar brands.
failureTaxonomy.likelyCause: Generic comparative claims without an identified reference food are misclassified as benign commercial puffery by unguided LLM prompts.
failureTaxonomy.proposedCorrection: Enforce FTC/FDA substantiation rule: quantitative comparative claims require explicit reference food and substantiated comparison basis.

failureTaxonomy.draftSnippet: Engineering teams may bypass external accessibility audits for quick beta releases.
failureTaxonomy.likelyCause: Rules-only engine assumed internal communications were exempt from public marketing governance checks.
failureTaxonomy.proposedCorrection: Extend policy governance checking to all channels, enforcing zero-bypass corporate mandates (WCAG 2.1 AA) across internal memos.

failureTaxonomy.draftSnippet: Proudly operating as a 100% Net Zero Certified food manufacturer.
failureTaxonomy.likelyCause: Keyword rule triggered on 'Net Zero' but could not determine that the underlying ISO 14064 certification expired in 2025.
failureTaxonomy.proposedCorrection: Mechanical expiration date validation (effectiveTo < reviewDate) in retrieval gate.

layerRemovalRecommendation.recommendation: REPLACE WITH GROUNDED DETERMINISTIC + HYBRID PIPELINE
layerRemovalRecommendation.rationale: Single-call ungrounded RAG exhibits unacceptable false-negative rates on statutory, temporal, and numeric boundaries (only 25% recall). Multi-layer mechanical grounding (Conditions C and D) achieves 100% precision and 100% recall without hallucinated citations.
